title: Rewind (DJ pull-up)
description: Pulls the record back like a DJ: the music stops, only the scratch is heard (for example 2 s), and the music goes on from an earlier place of the same sound (for example 5 s back). Times are those of the block, as you hear it. Several events work in one pass. Connect a real scratch sample to fx for the most realistic sound.

inputs.name: fx
inputs.title: Scratch sound
inputs.description: A real scratch sample (a CC0 one from ample_find_samples): it is heard during every scratch instead of the sound made from the music.

outputs.name: region
outputs.title: Scratches
outputs.description: Only the scratches (the rest is silence), as a region: connect it to the region_in input of an echo or a filter, and bring the result back with a region-merge block (its body input takes the rewind audio).

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the sound through untouched (bypass).

parameters.name: events
parameters.placeholder: at 6s scratch 2s back 5s; at 14s scratch 1s back 2s
parameters.doc: The rewinds, separated by ; Each one: at <time> scratch <length> back <length>. A time is seconds (6s), milliseconds (500ms) or decimal bars from the start of the block (4.5). back is how far the music jumps back after the scratch; a negative back (back -3s) jumps forward. Empty: the sound passes untouched.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.doc: What is heard during a scratch. auto: the sample on fx when one is connected, otherwise spin. spin: made from the music itself (the record read backwards at a falling speed). silence: a gap.

parameters.name: fade
parameters.doc: Fade at the cuts, so no cut clicks.

parameters.name: hardness
parameters.doc: How hard the cuts are: 100 is a hard cut, lower blends the scratch into the music (blend sets how long).

parameters.name: blend
parameters.doc: The length of the blend at 0% hardness; at 50% it is half as long.

parameters.name: smear
parameters.doc: The record kicks into gear: after a scratch the music starts at a speed near 0 and rises to full speed over this time (the pitch rises with it). 0 is a straight cut.

parameters.name: brake
parameters.doc: The music slows down to nothing over this time before a scratch, like a record that is braked. 0 is a straight cut.

parameters.name: curve
parameters.doc: motor: start-up and brake follow a turntable motor; linear: straight lines.

parameters.name: end
parameters.doc: When the music runs past the end of the sound: stop (silence) or loop (starts again).

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).
